name: Nscale
description: European GPU cloud with a no-card starter credit on serverless inference.
overview: Nscale is a European GPU cloud whose serverless inference API is OpenAI-compatible at inference.api.nscale.com/v1 with a 128K context. New accounts get $5 of starter credit without a card, which covers a few million tokens on smaller open models before switching to pay-as-you-go; no RPM or standing free catalogue is published, so treat the credit as a trial rather than a tier.
notes: Credit, not a recurring tier: plan for pay-as-you-go once the $5 is spent.
